properties.digitization_method: ADDED 2026-09-18 for Mission Bay's UCSF-garages pass: real OSM building footprint for UCSF's 1670 Owens Garage (entrance on C St off Owens, opposite Kaiser Permanente Mission Bay). OSM tags 5 levels/16 m height. 2026-09-29 accuracy audit: 'UCSF's garage; entrance on C St off Owens, opposite Kaiser Permanente Mission Bay' is not stated by the cited sources: the Mission Bay TMA lists '1670 Owens St. Garage' without the 'UCSF' prefix it gives the three UCSF garages, and nothing cited mentions C St or Kaiser. UCSF operation is plausible (the Assessor roll for parcel 8709022 shows a College/University exemption, queried 2026-09-29) but is not in a cited source. 2026-10-02: public-text pass. accuracy_caveat reworded for readers (meaning unchanged; no change to the shape, status, use or geometry_type); previous wording -- accuracy_caveat: 'REAL -- surveyed OpenStreetMap building footprint, not a hand trace or plan estimate. The footprint lies in active Assessor parcel 8709022 (1670 Owens St; in the secured roll, class 'Garages (Commercial)', year built 2010, 7 stories, College/University exemption in the 2025 roll), so a blklot exists that could be joined through status.csv; the real OSM building footprint is kept as the geometry. Neither cited source (OSM, the Mission Bay TMA rates page) says the garage is UCSF-owned.'.
properties.accuracy_caveat: REAL -- surveyed OpenStreetMap building footprint, not a hand trace or plan estimate. The footprint lies in active Assessor parcel 8709022 (1670 Owens St; in the secured roll, class 'Garages (Commercial)', year built 2010, 7 stories, College/University exemption in the 2025 roll), so a block/lot exists that this record could be mapped from; the real OSM building footprint is kept as the geometry. Neither cited source (OSM, the Mission Bay TMA rates page) says the garage is UCSF-owned.
